LESSON: LISTENING AND SPEAKING 10.1.1 PRONUNCIATION AND VOCABULARY

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 10
Topic 10.1: Listening and Speaking 10.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Listening and Speaking 10.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary, part of Strand 10 in Grade 4 ENGLISH LANGUAGE.

Key inquiry question: when making an oral presentation, • watch a video recorded riddling session or listen to an audio recording, 1. Why should we listen to others?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. repeat words with the sounds /ɪ/, /iː/, /s/, /ʃ/ and /əʊ/ after the teacher or audio recordings accurately,

2. tell riddles with words containing the sounds /ɪ/, /iː/, /s/, /ʃ/ and /əʊ/ with peers,

3. interact with a speaker or presenter through verbal and non-verbal cues,

4. engage the audience

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. repeat words with the sounds /ɪ/, /iː/, /s/, /ʃ/ and /əʊ/ after the teacher or audio recordings accurately,
2. tell riddles with words containing the sounds /ɪ/, /iː/, /s/, /ʃ/ and /əʊ/ with peers,
3. interact with a speaker or presenter through verbal and non-verbal cues,
4. engage the audience

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Listening and Speaking 10.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and Collaboration: This competence are developed when the learner says the words correctly and when

working with peers.

• Self-efficacy: It is developed when the learner communicates accurately thereby enhancing their confidence.

Values:
• Love: It is nurtured when the learner puts the interest of others before their own interests during collaborative activities.

• Responsibility: This is encouraged as the learner solves the given problems proactively by making oral presentations as

assigned.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

The learner’s self-esteem is enhanced as they acquire better self-expression and pronunciation ability through engaging in

various activities for interactive listening and turn-taking.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The learner applies the skills of interactive listening to all learning areas as listening is a key skill for effective learning.
